messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer onboarding sample app fails on Cloudflare Workers with crypt/stream errors. Stack: "ReferenceError: stream is not defined" and "crypto.createHmac is not a function". Anyone seen this?
jon: Yup, Workers doesn't have Node core APIs. Use Web Crypto + ReadableStream patterns instead of crypto.createHmac / stream.Readable.
ashok: We should add a tiny worker-friendly shim in the JS SDK that: detects runtime, swaps HMAC to WebCrypto, avoids Buffer, and uses fetch polyfill only if needed. Minimal and opt-in.
lia: Also a TS pain: many examples assume Node types (Buffer, process). Customers hit missing types unless they add "lib": ["es2020", "dom"] in tsconfig. We should document a worker-ts target.
maria: Current sample used node-fetch + crypto.createHmac. Can't ship that for CF. Quick workaround would be to show a Cloudflare-specific sample that uses WebCrypto and a small base64 helper.
jon: For HMAC in Workers:
```
// WebCrypto HMAC
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
const sigBuf = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(message));
const sigB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(sigBuf)));
```
This avoids Buffer entirely.
lia: For typings, add this note in README: "If targeting Workers, add \"dom\" to tsconfig.lib and avoid Buffer usage; use Uint8Array/btoa for base64." Small copy paste helps.
nashok: Another gotcha: our SDK retry implementation uses setTimeout/backoff to schedule retries. Workers have very limited/no long-running timers — setTimeout exists but not guaranteed for long delays. We should provide an immediate-retry strategy variant (sync backoff) or allow host-provided scheduler.
maria: Good call. For auth token refresh we currently kick off a background refresh (setInterval). That's incompatible with serverless edge. We need a fallback: refresh-on-401 sync flow + short-lived token header model.
jon: Detection helper we can ship in SDK:
```
export const isEdgeRuntime = () => typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && !!globalThis.crypto && typeof process === 'undefined';
```
Then wire different defaults (no background refresh, use WebCrypto, no node-streams).
lia: Also update examples to show bundler config: esbuild target=es2020, platform=browser, format=esm. Document the exports field so consumers using CJS don't accidentally pull node-only entry.
maria: Can someone add a new sample under /samples/worker-onboarding and a short Quickstart blurb? This is a high-friction onboarding failure. :point_up: 
nashok: I'll draft the shim PR: tiny runtime adapter + detection + opt-in export (e.g., import { edgeAdapter } from '@redwood/inference/sdk/edge'). Will add tests against Miniflare.
lia: I'll update TS docs and add a note about not assuming Buffer/process and include the webcrypto snippet.
jon: Also add a QA test in CI that runs the samples with Miniflare to catch regressions.
maria: Perfect. One more UX ask: in the hosted error page we could detect "ReferenceError: stream is not defined" and show a link to the worker onboarding doc. That would save a support ticket.
deploy-bot: canary deploy r-2026.3.4-012345 succeeded :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — assigning followups: @ashok sample + PR, @lia ts docs, @jon CI test. I'll file the onboarding ticket.
jon: :thumbsup:
lia: :rocket:
